verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that AI Gateway API keys and budgets exist, but nothing documents creating or managing them through an admin API. The Vercel openapi.json probe only proves a platform-level spec exists. It does not show any endpoints for AI Gateway keys, budgets, or gateway provisioning, so it is a host-platform signal rather than product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision gateways, keys, and budgets programmatically through an admin API
